title: How urldecode and rawurldecode handle the plus sign
summary: urldecode converts the literal plus sign to a space, rawurldecode preserves it.
detail: When you enter A+B%2BC, you get A B+C and A+B+C respectively. The percent-encoded plus sign in the former still resolves to a plus sign.
boundary: Fields that have already been parsed by the form layer may have lost the original plus sign, and repeated decoding cannot determine the original bytes.
relevance: Explain why plus signs and spaces in request records are interchanged when reconstructing the text.
